name: A Taste of Home
summary: Arille Azuregaze in Dalaran longs for Silvermoon Shimmerwine from her homeland. She asks you to bring her more bottles from northern Azshara.

sections.title: A Familiar Flavor
sections.body: Arille Azuregaze misses Silvermoon Shimmerwine, a wine with a delicate flavor found only in the vineyards of Eversong. In Dalaran, she says it is difficult to find beyond the Thalassian Gate. A patron once brought her a bottle taken from blood elves in northern Azshara, and now she asks you to bring her ten more.

faq.answer: Arille Azuregaze asks you to bring her ten bottles of Silvermoon Shimmerwine.

faq.q: Where does Silvermoon Shimmerwine come from?
faq.answer: Silvermoon Shimmerwine comes from the vineyards of Eversong.

faq.q: Why does Arille miss this wine?
faq.answer: Arille says Silvermoon Shimmerwine is the one thing she truly misses from her homeland.
A patron brought Arille a bottle he said he had taken from blood elves in northern Azshara.

faq.q: Where should I bring the bottles?
faq.answer: Bring the bottles to Arille Azuregaze in Dalaran.
